Senior PM — Payouts, fintech, London hybrid.

Settle (London, 65 people) just closed a Series B led by a tier-one fund after growing revenue 5x in a year. It builds instant payouts for marketplaces and gig platforms. We're hiring a Senior PM to own the payout experience for recipients: onboarding, payout speed tiers and pricing on instant transfers. No direct reports, reporting to the Head of Product. Hybrid, two days a week. Fintech experience is essential; pricing-experiment experience is a big plus.

label_v2.edge_note: P1-level fit lifted one tier by a strongly growing company
